overview_description.description: Anrok provides a software platform for global sales tax and VAT compliance. It handles integration with billing, payment, and HR systems to monitor tax exposure, validate VAT IDs, automate sales tax calculations, manage registrations, and coordinate filing and remittance processes. The company supports real-time tax collection, tracking of physical and economic nexus and consolidated compliance reporting across jurisdictions. It offers no-code and API‐based connections to finance stacks, facilitating audit-ready transaction logs and jurisdictional coverage for digital services and goods.

identifier.value: Anrok Global Sales Tax Compliance Platform

product.name: Anrok Global Sales Tax Compliance Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that manages sales tax and VAT compliance from nexus monitoring and registration through calculation, filing, remittance, reconciliation, and audit reporting.

product.name: US Sales Tax
product.description: End-to-end US sales tax software that monitors economic and physical nexus, supports registration, calculates tax, prepares and files returns, remits payments, and reconciles transactions.

product.name: Global VAT & GST
product.description: A global VAT and GST compliance service covering exposure monitoring, registration, tax calculation, VAT ID validation, filing, remittance, reconciliation, and audit-ready reporting.

product.name: Anrok Atlas
product.description: An AI-powered tax assistant built into Anrok that answers sales tax questions using a customer’s account data and Anrok’s tax knowledge base, with visible reasoning steps.

product.name: E-invoicing
product.description: A cross-border e-invoicing solution that generates required structured invoices, validates jurisdiction-specific data, and transmits invoices through appropriate channels such as Peppol.

product.name: Exemption Certificate Management
product.description: A system for creating, uploading, validating, storing, and tracking sales tax exemption certificates, including expiration and jurisdiction details, with transaction reprocessing support.
